summary: Comprehensive testing of notification system feature for ServiceFlow SaaS CRM platform. All backend API endpoints and frontend UI components tested and passed.
seed_data_creation: Created test leads during testing for notification trigger verification (TEST_* prefixed). Test data cleaned up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification system fully tested. Backend endpoints: GET /api/v1/admin/notifications (list), GET /api/v1/admin/notifications/unread-count, PATCH /api/v1/admin/notifications/{id}/read (mark single as read), PATCH /api/v1/admin/notifications/mark-all-read (mark all as read), DELETE /api/v1/admin/notifications/{id} (delete). Frontend: Bell icon with unread badge in AdminLayout header, notifications page at /admin/notifications with filter buttons, mark read, delete actions. Notification triggers work for: new leads (new_lead type), project status changes (project_status type).

backend: test_get_notifications_list - GET /api/v1/admin/notifications returns list with correct structure
test_create_lead_triggers_notification - creating a lead creates new_lead notification
test_mark_notification_as_read - PATCH /{id}/read marks notification as read
test_mark_all_notifications_read - PATCH /mark-all-read marks all as read
test_notification_types - all notifications have valid types
frontend: Notification bell icon is visible in admin header
Notification bell shows unread count badge
Click bell navigates to notifications page
